g.text: The cross marks the center, not an exact root position.
A positive real period: exactly two conjugate factors vanish
Proof: RPZ1–19 and RPCJ1–8. Full original matrix, unit and factor signs retained.
Inclusion arithmetic: Fredrik Johansson, Arb, arXiv:1611.02831v1. This is a geometric coefficient member; no arithmetic zeta-zero identification.
